Welcome to the RuneScape Wiki!

We are the official RuneScape encyclopaedia, written and maintained by the players. Since our start in 2005, we've become the largest and most comprehensive reference for the game, with 92,680 articles and counting.

Number of articles: 92,680
Number of files: 197,962
Number of active editors: 963
Number of edits: 10,035,547
